name: gtm-consent
description: Diagnose pasted Tag Assistant events and consent settings, with an event-by-event explanation, likely fixes and the precise next trace needed. Use when consent stays denied after acceptance, defaults appear late, Google tags are blocked, or regional settings disagree. Works from pasted text and container exports for marketing teams and developers. Review consent defaults, updates, template APIs and tag consent checks without account setup.
